title: Skin Lesion Classification
description: Classify a skin image as suspicious, benign, or normal skin.
long_description: This project allows you to train a YOLO-based model to group a close-up skin image or video as suspicious (melanoma, basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, and actinic keratosis), benign (nevus and seborrheic keratosis), or normal skin with no lesion. It assists a clinician by putting suspicious images first, before the rest of the list. The camera is aimed at one close-up of skin. The model is suitable for an MCU board such as PSOC™ Edge.
